component.name: Morpheus
component.summary: Chat, voice and video on Matrix

description.p: Morpheus is a Matrix client laid out like Discord: servers down the side, their channels next to them, and voice channels you join with one click. It talks to any Matrix homeserver, so you keep your account and rooms and can talk with people on Element and other clients.

ul.li: Servers (Matrix spaces) with text and voice channels, direct messages and threads
End-to-end encryption, with device verification and secure backup
Voice and video calls, screen sharing, and voice channels
Replies, reactions, edits, pinned messages, search and a command palette

screenshot.caption: A server's channel, with reactions, a reply and the member list
A shared picture and a thread
Jumping to any room or setting from the keyboard

description.p: Calls as in Discord (cards for everyone, one-click voice channels, ringing for direct calls), Discord's keyboard shortcuts, its layout, an encryption lock on every room, and fixes to scrolling through long rooms.
